instruction: Cook the rice according to package directions.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, and lemon juice together.
Cook the salmon until nearly done, then add the glaze and reduce until glossy.
Steam or sauté the broccoli until crisp-tender.
Assemble rice, salmon, and broccoli in bowls and garnish with green onion.
Cook the pasta until al dente, reserving some pasta water.
Sauté garlic briefly, then add chickpeas and warm through.
Add cream, Parmesan, and a splash of pasta water; stir until smooth.
Fold in spinach until wilted, then toss with the cooked pasta.
